tests.name: json_view_pointer_leading_zero
tests.intent: Verify that a json_pointer token with a leading zero like 01 on a null value in editable_document creates an object instead of throwing a parse error.

tests.name: json_view_pointer_empty_token
tests.intent: Verify that an empty json_pointer token on a null value in editable_document correctly creates an object or handles it without unexpected parsing crash.

tests.name: json_view_pointer_valid_array_index
tests.intent: Verify that a valid array index token like 1 on a null value creates an array in editable_document.

tests.name: json_view_pointer_single_zero
tests.intent: Verify that a single zero token 0 on a null value correctly creates an array.

tests.name: json_view_pointer_dash_token
tests.intent: Verify that a hyphen token - on a null value creates an array.

tests.name: json_view_pointer_alpha_token
tests.intent: Verify that an alphabetic token on a null value creates an object container.

tests.name: json_view_pointer_large_digits
tests.intent: Verify that a large sequence of digits without leading zero creates an array index.

tests.name: json_view_pointer_multiple_leading_zeros
tests.intent: Verify that multiple leading zeros like 007 create an object member rather than an array index.

tests.name: json_view_pointer_nested_mixed_tokens
tests.intent: Verify deeply nested pointers combining valid array indexes and non-index digit tokens.

tests.name: json_view_editable_document_update
tests.intent: Verify updating an already existing key through set() with valid and invalid index tokens.

tests.name: json_view_pointer_negative_digits
tests.intent: Verify that a token with a minus sign and digits like -1 behaves as an object member.

tests.name: json_view_pointer_special_chars
tests.intent: Verify that tokens containing punctuation or spaces create proper object keys.

tests.name: json_view_pointer_empty_string_document
tests.intent: Verify constructing a json_document with an empty object and setting an invalid index path.

tests.name: json_view_pointer_integer_boundaries
tests.intent: Verify extremely large digit strings that exceed normal integer bounds as object keys.

tests.name: json_view_pointer_mixed_case_digits
tests.intent: Verify digit strings mixed with letters create object members.

tests.name: json_view_pointer_array_padding
tests.intent: Verify proper null padding behavior when setting a high valid array index.

tests.name: json_view_pointer_multiple_slashes
tests.intent: Verify handling of multiple consecutive slashes or trailing slashes in json pointers.

tests.name: json_view_pointer_root_assignment
tests.intent: Verify setting on the root json pointer itself.

tests.name: json_view_pointer_whitespace_token
tests.intent: Verify tokens containing whitespace characters create object keys successfully.

tests.name: json_view_pointer_boolean_value_set
tests.intent: Verify setting boolean values via json_pointer with non-standard digit tokens.
